title: Dogs didn’t like the hoof, enjoyed the creepy snout with bug inside
text: I ordered the chews in the smallest size for my 12-13lb dogs. They were pretty big for them but no big deal. They didn’t care for chewing the hooves, but they like to carry them around and hide them. I went to open one of the packages of what looked like an exploded pig snout. Whatever it was looked like some kind of bubbling fried pork cracklin so that’s my best guess. As I was trying to split the piece in half for my 2 dogs, out crawls a little bug. The package was sealed and everything, this bug was born and raised inside this pig snout, how creepy. Anyway my dogs took the snout and ran off to enjoy. They loved it. I hope they don’t get sick, it was just a little brown bug. Will update if they do.
label: neutral
